Assign latitude and longitude columns to an sf point object

Source: R/bag_assign_latlong.R
bag_assign_latlong.Rd

Transforms the object to WGS 84, reads off latitude and longitude as columns, and transforms back to the input CRS.

Usage

bag_assign_latlong(dat = NULL, col_lat = "lat", col_lon = "lon")

Arguments

dat

An sf data frame of POINT geometry.

col_lat

character Name of the column to hold the latitude.

col_lon

character Name of the column to hold the longitude.

Value

An sf data frame in the input CRS, with latitude and longitude columns appended.

See also

bag_assign_utm() for UTM zone, easting and northing.

Other coordinates: bag_assign_utm(), bag_sf_from_utm()

Examples

sf_df <- data.frame(lon = -128.5, lat = 54.5) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326) |>
  sf::st_transform(3005)

bag_assign_latlong(sf_df, col_lon = "long")
#> Simple feature collection with 1 feature and 2 fields
#> Geometry type: POINT
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: 838509.3 ymin: 1058270 xmax: 838509.3 ymax: 1058270
#> Projected CRS: NAD83 / BC Albers
#>                   geometry   long  lat
#> 1 POINT (838509.3 1058270) -128.5 54.5
